svg.text: Litere de mână (draft v1): the handwritten model for planets 1-3
Traced by eye from two Romanian clasa I manuals (Corint Logistic 2023 and Art Klett 2023). Compare with the manual; tell the agent what differs.
Green dot: where a stroke starts; its number is its order. Pink arrow: the direction. Orange: entry stroke (from the line) and exit stroke (to the next letter).
Lines as in the 'tip I' notebook: dashed top line, solid middle line, solid baseline, dashed line below; the letters lean right (about 79 degrees).
